name: Pet hydrotherapy and rehab

pf.license.need: Optional, and Rosie checks nothing. The center may list each therapist's license or credential, where the state licenses the work, and any insurance it carries; Rosie shows what the center enters, as given.
pf.license.ask: Optional: each therapist's license or credential and its end date, as the center keeps them.
pf.license.who holds it: The center; each therapist; the referring vet's clearance letter is the owner's own.
pf.license.how it's checked: Rosie does not check, look up or verify any license, credential, insurance or vet letter (D96). The center's own word only.
pf.license.blocks going live: None for a license: nothing is held back because a credential is not on the page.
pf.license.renewals: None tracked by Rosie; the center keeps its own dates.
pf.license.insurance or bond: Optional: the center may list its liability insurance; Rosie does not check it.
pf.license.background check: The center's own choice; Rosie does not run one.
pf.license.own word: If the center says a session needs a credential a therapist doesn't have, that therapist isn't offered it (the center's own word, not a check).

pf.services.shape: Pet hydrotherapy and rehab: an assessment, then sessions in a warm-water pool or on a land treadmill, with a home exercise plan; a referring vet's clearance comes first; in person at the center, and at the owner's home for some exercises.
pf.services.examples: The example center's own prices, not a standard. A pet insurance plan may pay part of a rehab plan; the center's own way.

pf.services.capacity: one pet per therapist at a time in the pool; one pet per session at home
pf.services.skills: rehab therapist (the assessment and the plan), by kind of session (pool, treadmill, home)
pf.services.online: none: every session is in person

before times: Which kind of session: an assessment, a pool or treadmill session, or a home visit?
Is the pet a dog or a cat, and about how big is it?
Will an insurance plan pay? Just its name here.
after a time is picked: Anything that helps the session, like a step-free way in, or a towel and a leash for the pool.
Does the pet need a muzzle, or does it bite or lunge when handled? (yes or no here; details on the secure page)
only on the secure page: The referring vet's clearance letter (the vet's name and the date it was written)
Vaccine record, and any medicine the pet takes
What the injury or surgery was, and when, as the vet describes it
The owner's consent and the waiver for the pool
Who brings and collects the pet, and their phone number
pf.questions.whoMayBook: The pet's owner; an adult the owner names in writing (a pet sitter or a family member); a referring vet's office for its patient.

stop.words: the pet can't breathe, collapses, bleeds badly, or may have eaten poison
stop.say: Call your emergency vet now, or the animal poison line. Don't wait for a rehab session.

stop.words: crisis words from a person, or thoughts of harming yourself
a bite or attack that hurt a person
stop.say: Call 911 if someone is hurt, then your animal control line. The center books nothing until the vet has seen the pet.

goOn.words: a recent surgery, or a new injury
goOn.what: no session until the referring vet's clearance letter is in and the therapist has read it

goOn.words: a pet that is pregnant, or could be
goOn.what: the referring vet decides before any session; the therapist asks again at the session

goOn.words: a pet that bites, lunges or is hard to handle
goOn.what: the therapist may decline the session or ask for a muzzle; the owner is told before the session

pf.safety.medical questions: Never answered: what a diagnosis means, whether a medicine is right, or whether a pet needs surgery. Those go to the referring vet. Rosie gives no animal health advice.

required.name: The referring vet's clearance letter
required.when: by the day before the assessment
required.who: the owner's own vet sends it, or the owner uploads a copy on the secure page
required.result: not in by the day before: the center's desk asks the vet's office; still not in, the session can't go ahead

required.name: Waiver and consent
required.who: the owner, on the secure page

required.name: Vaccine record
required.who: the owner, on the secure page
required.result: the center's own rule for a pool session applies; no record, no pool session

pf.first_steps.prep for the reminder: On a secure link: what to bring (the leash, a towel, the vaccine record, any medicine the pet takes), and to keep the pet from food for two hours before a pool session.
pf.first_steps.prep timing: The two-hour food rule starts the morning of a pool session; the prep link goes in the confirmation whenever it starts before the next reminder.

pf.visit.check-in: The check-in code at the front desk. A home visit: the code at the door.
pf.visit.at the visit: The therapist checks the clearance letter, the waiver and the pet's handling before any session. The owner stays for the first session.
pf.visit.work changes: A change to the plan comes only from the therapist, with the referring vet's OK for any change to the injury's treatment.
pf.visit.stops: A pet that is unwell, a clearance letter the therapist won't accept, or a pet that won't be handled safely: that session doesn't go ahead; another time, with no fee.
pf.visit.what proves it's done: The check-in code, or DONE when the session ends.
pf.visit.results: The therapist's session notes go to the owner and to the referring vet through the center's own system. Rosie never texts a result.

pf.money.before: Nothing taken at booking (the starting answer). A package of four sessions is paid in full when booked, after the written estimate.
pf.money.after: At the center: paid at the front desk after the session, card or cash, the center's own way. At home: one bill from Rosie after the visit, with the trip included. An insurance claim is the owner's own way.
pf.money.fees: A no-show or a late cancel within 24 hours: $40, only if the owner says yes, and only where a card was saved at booking.
pf.money.rosfield: Rosfield's $2 per booking applies as for every business (D97); the center pays it, never the owner.

pf.messages.never in a text: The injury, the diagnosis, the medicine, and the vet's letter. Texts name the pet's first name, the center, the date, the time, the place and a secure link.
pf.messages.results: Never in a text; 'your vet has the report' at most.
pf.messages.languages: English and Spanish, plus the center's interpreter line.
pf.messages.minors: An adult owner books. A child may bring the pet only with an adult who stays.

pf.staff.roles: Rehab therapists (as licensed where the state licenses the work), a referring-vet liaison on the team (where the center has one), and the front desk.
pf.staff.supervision: A plan change is the therapist's; a change to the injury's medical treatment is the referring vet's.
pf.staff.skills: each therapist's session kinds, as the center lists them
pf.staff.who OKs: The therapist OKs the plan and any change to it; a front-desk person doesn't.
pf.staff.stand-ins: Another therapist with the same skill. An owner who asked for a particular therapist is asked before anyone else is booked; nobody moves on silence.
pf.staff.chaperone: Not needed for a pet; an adult stays with a child who brings a pet.

pf.rules.orders: No session without the referring vet's clearance letter and the waiver.
pf.rules.health privacy: The center's own records of a pet's care are kept in its own system; Rosie carries no medical record.
pf.rules.claims: No claim in any text or booking page that a treatment cures or heals a pet.
pf.rules.results: Session notes go to the owner and the referring vet through the center's own system; Rosie never carries them.
pf.rules.records: Records kept as long as the center's rules require, in its own system; an owner's copy within 30 days.
pf.rules.minors: A child may bring a pet only with an adult who stays.
pf.rules.animals: A pet's records are the owner's; a pet's name may appear in texts, its condition never does.

matter most.no clearance letter by the day before: The center's desk asks the vet's office; no letter, no session, no fee.
matter most.the pet won't be handled safely: The session is stopped with no fee, and the owner is told why.
matter most.a pet that bites: A muzzle, or no session; the owner is told before it's booked.
matter most.a child: An adult stays with a child who brings a pet.

pf.edges.the rest: All other edge cases are handled the generic way.

notes: Built Oct 27 2026 (K10, Haiku builder) from the refitted vet overlay (its S1-62 'No $2' was already off). Animal work: NOT sensitive (no switch set); licenses optional and never checked (D96): S1-60 and S2-28 keep both branches. Flow A money: list|none|counter (main: hydrotherapy session $85, paid at the desk after; the assessment $95), list|card|counter (a session with a card saved for a $40 no-show fee, charged only with the owner's yes), list|full|none (a four-session package, $340, paid in full when booked). Flow B: list|none|bill (main: home rehab visit $175, trip included, one bill after), list|none|own (insurance claim, the owner's own way). Safety: a pet emergency gets the emergency vet and the poison line, never 911 (911 only if a person is hurt). The vet's own steps are not carried over; the clearance letter is a first step (pf.first_steps).
